_comment: memory buys CPU as well as RAM on Vercel — they scale together — and this
function is not memory-hungry, it's latency-sensitive. 1024 roughly halves
the cold-start import time (httpx, the pipeline) that otherwise lands on
whoever presses the shutter first. Billing is GB-seconds, so a function that
costs twice as much per second and runs in half the time is close to a wash.
maxDuration is the ceiling the vision budget in vision.py is sized against —
if you raise one, raise the other.
